title: Kuusi Markdown Slides
description: Live slide deck appearance for Markdown Slides view.

fontSize.description: A size step, or a custom size in CSS px.

color.description: CSS hex color, or empty to follow the slide text color.

theme.title: Slides theme
theme.description: Color theme for the slide stage.

splitMode.title: Slide split mode
splitMode.description: How Markdown is split into slides: outline (# / ## / ### each start a slide; --- optional), rules only, or headings only.

contentAlign.title: Content alignment
contentAlign.description: Vertical alignment of content inside the slide stage.

listDensity.title: List density (deprecated)
listDensity.description: Deprecated: use paragraphSpacing. Read once to seed paragraph spacing.

font.title: Slides body font
font.description: Font family for slide body text.

lineHeight.title: Slides leading
lineHeight.description: Line-height multiplier for slide body text (0.9–2.4).

textColor.title: Slides body color
textColor.description: Body text color. Empty follows the slide foreground.

letterSpacing.title: Slides letter spacing
letterSpacing.description: Tracking for body text, in pt (0–3).

paragraphSpacing.title: Slides paragraph spacing
paragraphSpacing.description: Vertical space between body paragraphs, in pt (0–48).

paragraphIndent.title: Slides paragraph indent
paragraphIndent.description: First-line indent for body paragraphs, in pt (0–72).

linkStyle.title: Slides link style
linkStyle.description: How hyperlinks are emphasized on slides.

headers.title: Slides headers
headers.description: Per-level heading styles (H1–H6): font, size, color, and alignment.

codeStyle.title: Slides code style
codeStyle.description: Appearance of inline code and fenced code blocks.

codeTheme.title: Slides code palette
codeTheme.description: Syntax colors for highlighted code. Notebook follows JupyterLab theme colors.

codeFont.title: Slides code font
codeFont.description: Monospace face for code on slides.

accentColor.title: Slide accent color
accentColor.description: Override accent / chrome color. Empty follows the theme.

headingScale.title: Heading scale (deprecated)
headingScale.description: Deprecated: use headers. Read once to seed H1/H2 sizes.

showNavButtons.title: Show navigation buttons
showNavButtons.description: Show previous / next buttons under the stage.

showPageNumber.title: Show page number
showPageNumber.description: Show the page number on the slide footer (not the under-stage nav).

pageNumberStyle.title: Slide page number style
pageNumberStyle.description: Format for the on-slide footer page number.

pageNumberAlign.title: Slide page number alignment
pageNumberAlign.description: Horizontal placement of the on-slide footer page number.

pageNumberStart.title: Slide page number start
pageNumberStart.description: Number from the first slide, or skip the first and start on slide 2.

showHeader.title: Show slide header
showHeader.description: Show the Beamer-style header bar on the stage.

headerSource.title: Slide header source
headerSource.description: Header text from a running H1/H2/H3, or a custom string.

headerCustomText.title: Custom slide header
headerCustomText.description: Header text when source is Custom. Empty hides the title.

headerHeight.title: Slide header height
headerHeight.description: Height of the in-stage header bar in px.

headerFont.title: Slide header font
headerFont.description: Font of the header bar text; empty follows the slide font.

footerText.title: Slide footer text
footerText.description: Footer template with {title}, {chapter}, {section}, {subsection}, {page}, {total} and {date}. Empty shows the deck title.

footerFont.title: Slide footer font
footerFont.description: Font of the footer text and page number; empty follows the slide font.

headerColor.title: Slide header color
headerColor.description: CSS hex color of the header bar, or empty to follow the accent color.

headerTextColor.title: Slide header text color
headerTextColor.description: CSS hex color of the header text, or empty for white.

footerRuleWidth.title: Slide footer divider width
footerRuleWidth.description: Thickness of the line above the footer in px (0 hides it).

footerColor.title: Slide footer text color
footerColor.description: CSS hex color of the footer text, or empty to follow the theme.

footerBackground.title: Slide footer background
footerBackground.description: CSS hex color behind the footer, or empty for none.

progressHeight.title: Progress bar thickness
progressHeight.description: Thickness of the progress bar in px.

progressColor.title: Progress bar color
progressColor.description: CSS hex color of the progress bar, or empty to follow the accent color.

progressShadow.title: Progress bar glow
progressShadow.description: Soft glow under the progress bar.

showFooter.title: Show footer bar
showFooter.description: Show the Beamer-style footer strip on the stage.

showProgress.title: Show progress bar
showProgress.description: Show a thin progress bar along the bottom of the stage.

stageShadow.title: Stage shadow
stageShadow.description: Cast a drop shadow under the slide stage.

codeFrame.title: Slides code frame
codeFrame.description: Draw a border around fenced code blocks.

codeFrameColor.title: Slides code frame color
codeFrameColor.description: CSS hex color, or empty to follow the slide foreground.

codeFrameRadius.title: Slides code corner radius
codeFrameRadius.description: Corner radius of code blocks, in px (0–24).

codeFrameBorder.title: Slides code frame stroke
codeFrameBorder.description: Border width of the code frame, in px (0–8).

codeFrameWidth.title: Slides code block width
codeFrameWidth.description: Maximum width of code blocks, as percent of the slide (40–100).

tableStyle.title: Table style
tableStyle.description: Word- and LaTeX-inspired table presets (default Booktabs).

tableBorderWidth.title: Table border width
tableBorderWidth.description: Rule / grid stroke thickness in pt (0.25–3).

tableTransparency.title: Table background transparency
tableTransparency.description: Transparency of table cell fills in percent: 100 lets the page show through, 0 keeps opaque rows.

tableHeaderRowBold.title: Bold table header row
tableHeaderRowBold.description: Make the first row (column headers) bold.

tableHeaderColumnBold.title: Bold table first column
tableHeaderColumnBold.description: Make the first column (row headers) bold.

tableHeaderRowAlign.title: Slides table header row alignment
tableHeaderRowAlign.description: Text alignment of the table header row; auto keeps the table style's own.

tableHeaderColumnAlign.title: Slides table header column alignment
tableHeaderColumnAlign.description: Text alignment of the first column; auto keeps the table style's own.

tableColumnWidth.title: Slides table column width
tableColumnWidth.description: Table column sizing: auto fits each column to its content, equal gives every column the same width.

listStyle.title: List style
listStyle.description: Vertical density for unordered and ordered lists.

blockquoteWeight.title: Blockquote weight
blockquoteWeight.description: Border and emphasis weight for blockquotes.

hrThickness.title: Divider thickness
hrThickness.description: Thickness of horizontal rules in px; 0 follows the divider weight.

hrColor.title: Divider color
hrColor.description: Color of horizontal rules, as a CSS color; empty keeps the divider weight's own.

imageWidth.title: Slides image width
imageWidth.description: How wide images may grow on a slide.

imageAlign.title: Slides image alignment
imageAlign.description: Horizontal placement when images sit on their own line.

imageWrap.title: Slides image wrap
imageWrap.description: Whether following text wraps beside the image.

imageBorderColor.title: Slides image border color
imageBorderColor.description: CSS hex color, or empty to follow the slide foreground.

showTextCount.title: Show character / word count
showTextCount.description: Display character and word counts beside zoom.

showPageCount.title: Show page count
showPageCount.description: Display the slide count beside zoom.

showFileSize.title: Show file size
showFileSize.description: Display the document file size beside zoom.

strongColor.title: Slides bold color
strongColor.description: Color for bold (**strong**) body text. Empty inherits the body color.

codeBackground.title: Slides code background color
codeBackground.description: Background of fenced code blocks, as a CSS color; empty keeps the code theme's own.

blockquoteBackground.title: Slides quote background color
blockquoteBackground.description: Background of block quotes, as a CSS color; empty keeps the quote weight's own.

blockquoteColor.title: Slides quote text color
blockquoteColor.description: Text color of block quotes, as a CSS color; empty keeps the quote weight's own.

blockquoteBarColor.title: Slides quote bar color
blockquoteBarColor.description: Color of the vertical bar of block quotes, as a CSS color; empty keeps the quote weight's own.

imageScale.title: Slides image scale
imageScale.description: Display size of images as a percentage of the size chosen by Slides image width.
